variants.name: Normal
variants.howToObtain: Find in-game from Sprite Gizmos or wild encounters

variants.name: Gold
variants.howToObtain: Rare drop from Sprite Gizmos or evolve from Normal

variants.name: Gummy
variants.effect: 20% extra Sprite Dust from all sources.

variants.name: Galaxy
variants.effect: 30% more ammo from ammo boxes and eliminations.

variants.name: Holofoil
variants.effect: 5% increased chance to find rare Sprites.
variants.howToObtain: Very rare drop from Sprite Gizmos

variants.name: Cube
variants.howToObtain: Rare drop from Sprite Gizmos, more common in Storm zones

variants.name: Quack
variants.howToObtain: Very rare drop from Sprite Gizmos

variants.name: Cheat Master
variants.effect: Enhanced ability with reduced cooldown and increased power.
variants.howToObtain: Master a sprite to unlock Cheat Master variant

sprites.name: Llama
sprites.ability: Opening ammo boxes has a chance to grant a weapon upgrade. Chance increases at each Level Up: 5% -> 10% -> 15% -> 17% -> 20%
sprites.location: Found in Relic Chests

sprites.name: Duck
sprites.ability: Emoting or Jamming replenishes shields. Increases in power at each Level Up: 2 Shield -> 3 Shield -> 4 Shield -> 6 Shield -> 8 Shield per tick
sprites.location: Found in the vault of a certain business mogul

sprites.name: Ghost
sprites.ability: Grants cloak for a duration upon reloading. Increases in duration at each Level Up: 3 Seconds -> 3.5 Seconds -> 4 Seconds -> 4.5 Seconds -> 5 Seconds
sprites.location: Found in the world at nighttime

sprites.name: Dream
sprites.ability: Grants a random item at each level, exploding with legendary loot at Max Level. Loot value increases at each Level Up!
sprites.location: Sometimes found sleeping in the storage crates

sprites.name: King
sprites.ability: Your Pickaxe deals more damage. Increases in damage at each Level Up: 30 -> 40 -> 60 -> 80 -> 120 bonus damage
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: Demon
sprites.ability: Siphon some health and shields when you eliminate an opponent. Increases in power at each Level Up: 10 Healing -> 15 Healing -> 20 Healing -> 25 Healing -> 30 Healing per elimination
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: Burnt Peanut
sprites.ability: Goop! When eliminating players, you may find more loot. Sometimes mythic! Chance increases at each Level Up: 20% -> 30% -> 40% -> 50% -> 60% chance to find more loot. 10% chance to find Mythic at Max Level!
sprites.location: Found in Relic Chests

sprites.name: Boss
sprites.ability: Grants an increase to your max HP and Shield. Increases at each Level Up: 5 HP/Shield -> 10 HP/Shield -> 15 HP/Shield -> 20 HP/Shield -> 25 HP/Shield
sprites.location: Claimed from defeating a powerful adversary

sprites.name: Seven
sprites.ability: Enemy player foot trails are visible in the world for your Squad. Duration increases at each Level Up: 10 Seconds -> 15 Seconds -> 20 Seconds -> 25 Seconds -> 30 Second foot trails
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Fishy
sprites.ability: Swim speed greatly increased. Taking damage also briefly increases movement speed. Increases in power at each Level Up: 25% Swim Speed / 10% Movement Speed -> 50% Swim Speed / 20% Movement Speed -> 100% Swim Speed / 30% Movement Speed -> 150% Swim Speed / 40% Movement Speed -> 200% Swim Speed / 50% Movement Speed Bonuses
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Striker
sprites.ability: Gain the Overdrive effect when you Mantle, Hurdle, or Wall Scramble. Duration increases at each Level Up: 6 Seconds -> 7 Seconds -> 8 Seconds -> 9 Seconds -> 10 Seconds of Overdrive
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Aura
sprites.ability: Gain a Shock Rock charge when you deal enough damage to enemies! Required damage decreases at each Level Up: 175 Damage -> 150 Damage -> 125 Damage -> 100 Damage -> 75 Damage to trigger
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Air
sprites.ability: Increases sprinting speed and sprinting jump height. Also nullifies fall damage. Jump height increased with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Water
sprites.ability: Replenish shields while standing in water! Increases in power at each Level Up: 2 Shield -> 3 Shield -> 4 Shield -> 5 Shield -> 6 Shield per tick
sprites.location: Spotted near rivers and beaches

sprites.name: Ironmouse
sprites.ability: Regenerate health over time when low. While regenerating, gain Cloak and low gravity! Health regenerated to increases at each Level Up: 60 Health -> 70 Health -> 80 Health -> 90 Health -> 100 Health
sprites.location: Found in Relic Chests

sprites.name: Batman
sprites.ability: Grants the ability to deploy the Bat Cape midair!
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: John Wick
sprites.ability: Knocking players reveals others nearby. Mark duration increases at each Level Up: 3 Seconds -> 3.5 Seconds -> 4 Seconds -> 4.5 Seconds -> 5 Seconds
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: Vini Jr.
sprites.ability: Sprinting for a short time makes your slide destructive. Slidekicking enemies increases rate of fire and reload speed. Increases in power at each Level Up: 40 dmg / 10% fire rate -> 45 dmg / 20% fire rate -> 50 dmg / 30% fire rate -> 55 dmg / 40% fire rate -> 60 dmg / 50% fire rate
sprites.location: Found in Relic Chests

sprites.name: Peely
sprites.ability: Emits a ping for players with rare sprites nearby, but marks you on the map. Ping radius increases at each Level Up: 40m -> 50m -> 60m -> 70m -> 80m
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Pollo
sprites.ability: Upon earning an elimination, slowly replenish shield for you and nearby squad members for a duration. Duration increases at each Level Up: 6 Seconds -> 7 Seconds -> 8 Seconds -> 9 Seconds -> 10 Seconds

sprites.name: Earth
sprites.ability: You have a chance to find additional rare items when opening chests. Chance increases at each Level Up: 10% -> 12.5% -> 15% -> 17.5% -> 20% chance to find additional rare loot
sprites.location: Found wandering around forests and wooded regions

sprites.name: Fire
sprites.ability: Creates a fiery burst when you deal enough damage to an enemy! Required damage decreases at each Level Up: 150 Damage -> 125 Damage -> 100 Damage -> 75 Damage -> 50 Damage to trigger
sprites.location: Located near urban areas

sprites.name: Punk
sprites.ability: Possibly nothing... or infinitely something
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: Grim
sprites.ability: Players who attack you are marked for a duration. Increases in duration at each Level Up: 3 Seconds -> 3.5 Seconds -> 4 Seconds -> 4.5 Seconds -> 5 Seconds
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: Zero Point
sprites.ability: Spawn a Shield Bubble Jr. when you use a healing item on yourself (excluding splashes and grenades). Increases in duration at each Level Up: 6 Seconds -> 7 Seconds -> 8 Seconds -> 9 Seconds -> 10 Seconds
sprites.location: Found rarely in Sprite Chests

sprites.name: Jackrabbit
sprites.ability: (Active - Jump In Air) Double Jump. Cooldown between jumps decreases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Shadow
sprites.ability: Automatically reload unequipped weapons over time. Reloads equipped weapon at max level. Automatic reload gets faster with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Bush
sprites.ability: Grants a bush on you after a duration, gain a bush on elimination at max level. Time between bush activating decreases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near grassy areas and forests

sprites.name: Tails
sprites.ability: (Active - Jump In Air) Hover with the help of Tails! Hover speed increased with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Killswitch
sprites.ability: (Active - Aim In Air) Enter Hangtime with improved accuracy. Accuracy increases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Found in the world at nighttime

sprites.name: Adventure
sprites.ability: Upgrades a random item in the player's inventory with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Klombo
sprites.ability: Grants random items at each level, only levels up by consuming items. Item quality increases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Jonesy
sprites.ability: Recover some health or shields after being damaged after a short duration. Increase amount healed with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Sonic
sprites.ability: Gotta Go Fast! Sprint faster with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Crown
sprites.ability: Only levels up by winning matches. Level up faster with Crown Wins. New variants unlocked after mastering!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: 8-Bit
sprites.ability: Find an 8-Bit Shotgun in your first chest and gain a score multiplier for it.
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Storm Scout
sprites.ability: Applies Overdrive after taking a certain amount of storm damage. Reveals future Storm Circles at max level. Increases Overdrive duration with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Mega Man
sprites.ability: Slip and slide around with reduced friction while Sliding. Slide farther with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Overshield
sprites.ability: Grants overshield, scaling with level.
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: X-Ray
sprites.ability: Periodically mark enemies in an area around you. Mark more often with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Special spawn locations

sprites.name: Onigiri
sprites.ability: Applies Overdrive after eating or drinking a Consumable. Overdrive lasts longer with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Special spawn locations

sprites.name: Morgana
sprites.ability: Increases the effectiveness of healing items. Healing effectiveness increases with each Level Up!

sprites.name: Crash Bandicoot
sprites.ability: (Active - Jump In Air) Triggers a whirlwind attack, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies. Damage increases and cooldown decreases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Pond
sprites.ability: (Active) - Jump shortly after landing to trigger a Super Jump, if charges are present. Gain charges over time. Super jump strength increases and cooldown decreases with each Level Up!

sprites.name: Birthday
sprites.ability: Opening chests has a chance to spawn a piece of cake. Eliminations can spawn cake at max level. Chance to spawn cake increases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Spotted near high and mountainous areas

sprites.name: Blinky
sprites.ability: Grants cloak for a duration when you take damage. Cloak duration increases with each Level Up!
sprites.location: Found in the world at nighttime
